cds.title: Northeastern State University Common Data Set 2024-2025 (Excel)

ipeds.title: IPEDS College Navigator (profile, fall 2024 admissions and test scores, 2024-25 expenses)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (Fall 2024 entering class): 2,011 applied, 1,998 admitted (99.4%), 664 enrolled (592 in-state, 57 out-of-state, 15 international). The CDS gives no international applicant or admit counts. IPEDS College Navigator reports 1,727 applicants and 100% admitted for fall 2024, which differs from the CDS. NSU's 2025-2026 CDS Excel file was also posted but is incomplete and internally inconsistent (admits exceed applicants, SAT and cost sections blank), so the 2024-2025 CDS is used. Open-style admission with rolling decisions; no early decision or early action, no waitlist. The CDS reports ACT scores only (84.6% submitted; no SAT percentiles; College Navigator shows 4% submitted the SAT). Undergraduate enrollment 5,085 and nonresident count 189 are the B1/B2 'Total Undergraduates' figures (fall 2024).

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8A (2024-2025): ACT 'required for some'; the CDS marks standardized tests 'very important'. The CDS cost section (G) is blank.
